foreach ( $images as list( $id, $url, $name, $title ) ) {
	if ( get_post( $id ) ) {
		continue;
	}
	$tmp = download_url( $url );
	if ( is_wp_error( $tmp ) ) {
		continue;
	}
	$attachment_id = media_handle_sideload(
		array(
			'name'     => $name . '.jpg',
			'tmp_name' => $tmp,
		),
		0,
		null,
		array(
			'import_id'  => $id,
			'post_title' => $title,
		)
	);
	if ( is_wp_error( $attachment_id ) ) {
		@unlink( $tmp );
		continue;
	}
	update_post_meta( $attachment_id, '_wp_attachment_image_alt', $title );
}
update_option( 'vp_demo_media_seconds', round( microtime( true ) - $started, 1 ) );
